run_crownibp_bound_propagation: run Crown-IBP bound propagation on a function with input bounds to obtain output bounds
run_backward_crown_bound_propagation: run CROWN bound propagation on a function with input bounds to obtain output bounds
run_backward_fastlin_bound_propagation: run FastLin bound propagation on a function with input bounds to obtain output bounds

optimize_joint_bounds: jointly optimize all relaxation parameters in a network to minimize the range of final bounds
